name: Roshutsu Shoujo to Indou Kigu ~Tensai Kagakusha wa Mirareru no ga Osuki!~
original_name: 露出少女と淫動器具～天才科学者は見られるのがお好き！～
source:
My name is Kenji Shiraume, head scientist at Shiraume Engineering Lab.
Friends call me Professor.
Though I am the head of my lab, the truth is I'm also the lab's sole member.
However, I'm on the precipice of great achievements!
As recent custodian to a girl with world-recognized genius, we got grand money to recently upgrade my piddling facility to state of the art!
But she's also a pervert who's obsessed with exposing herself.

To provoke her genius mind into producing ideas, I built her a device to satisfy her desire.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117704.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫白梅健士，是白梅工程实验室的首席科学家。
朋友们都叫我教授。
虽说我是实验室的负责人，实际上，整个实验室也只有我一个人。
不过，我马上就要取得重大成果了！
最近，我接下了照管一位天才少女的任务。她的才华获得了全世界的认可，我们也因此得到一笔丰厚的资助，把我那简陋的小实验室升级成了配备尖端设备的设施！
可是，她也有变态的癖好，痴迷于在别人面前裸露身体。

为了激发她的天才头脑，让她想出新点子，我造了一件能满足她这种欲望的装置。

（摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117704.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
